description: This file is the client entry point for a Remix.run application, responsible for hydrating the app in the browser using React's hydrateRoot method. It sets up the app with React's StrictMode and renders the RemixBrowser component.

methods.name: startTransition
methods.description: React's method to schedule state updates concurrently, used here to start the hydration process.
